name: Expedition Modular Tackle Backpack
description: Carry everything for multi-day expeditions. Built with waterproof 1200D ballistic nylon, the Lucana Expedition backpack contains a hard-shelled sunglasses compartment, rod holding straps, and a modular lower vault that fits four 3700-sized tackle boxes.
features: Lower vault includes structural divider matching four large modular tackle bins
Integrated side sleeves with velcro straps clamp up to two rods during hiking
Ergonomic padded mesh shoulder harnesses distribute heavy weights evenly
Hardened crushproof top compartment protects delicate spectacles and reels

name: Tackle Utility Sling Bag
description: An ergonomic single-shoulder tackle sling designed for active shore-walkers. Swing the bag forward to access your lures and rigs without taking it off. Built from water-repellent tear-resistant ripstop.
features: Ambidextrous cross-body strap allows quick rotational swinging
Lower fold-down front pocket acts as a mobile work table during lure changes
Exterior sheath holds fishing pliers and retractors ready for instant access

name: Shoreline Messenger Waterproof Case
description: A fully waterproof, roll-top messenger dry bag designed for kayak and surf casting. Welded seams ensure no salt spray can find its way to your tackle or keys, even if dropped in the waves.
features: Roll-top closure with quick-release side buckles locks moisture out
High-visibility reflective piping keeps kayak anglers visible at night

name: Pro Organizer Waist Pack
description: A waist-worn fanny pack designed for stream-waders. Includes integrated fly patch foams, mesh beverage holders, and heavy webbing lines to clip indicators and line clippers.
features: Breathable 3D padded waist belt ensures comfortable wear on warm summer days
Removable ripple-foam fly board for quick hook switching
Double water bottle side pockets for longer stream treks

name: Waterproof Gear Duffel 90L
description: A massive 90-liter waterproof storage duffel built to haul your rods, clothing, boots, and tackle boxes for overseas fishing journeys. It features durable backpack-convertible straps and lockable zippers.

specifications.title: Compartments
specifications.value: 1 huge main cavity + 2 zipper side vaults

features: 90L extreme capacity holds composite multi-piece rod tubes up to 72cm length
Removable ergonomic backpack straps provide versatile portage modes
Reinforced heavy webbing grab handles on all four sides
